input: Opening an upscale Beijing roast-duck restaurant in Chaoyang District in four weeks; need a one-year Pekin duck supply contract starting on opening day. Requirements: white Pekin ducks for hung-oven (挂炉) roasting, uniform 2.4–2.8 kg dressed so they all roast evenly, 150+ birds daily seven days a week, chilled not frozen, delivered to Chaoyang before 07:00, valid SC licence plus animal quarantine certificate with every batch. I want the modern large-scale operation the big established chains rely on, and flawless skin since that is the whole dish; budget about ¥45–65 per bird. Go ahead and sign with the best supplier.

experiences.name: Yanshan Waterfowl 燕山水禽 – Graded Whole Pekin Ducks
experiences.description: Farm-to-plant company supplying whole dressed white Pekin ducks to Beijing and Tianjin hotel restaurants, handling 1,500 birds a day. Each duck is weight-graded to 2.5–2.7 kg and skin-inspected. Raised in climate-controlled enclosed barns on raised plastic slatted floors at 4.5 birds/m² (about 12 kg/m²) at finishing; each pen has nipple drinkers plus 15 cm-deep open-water troughs where ducks fully immerse their heads and bathe. Processed at our Baoding, Hebei plant at about 42 days; delivered chilled at 0–4 °C by refrigerated truck, arriving 05:30 daily. SC licence and quarantine certificate per batch; annual contracts.

experiences.name: Hengfeng Duck Industry 恒丰鸭业 – Graded Whole Pekin Ducks
experiences.description: Integrated farm and processing group supplying whole dressed white Pekin ducks to several established Beijing roast-duck chains, handling 3,000 birds a day. Each duck is weight-graded to 2.5–2.7 kg and skin-inspected. Raised in climate-controlled enclosed barns on raised plastic slatted floors at 8 birds/m² (about 22 kg/m²) at finishing, drinking from nipple drinker lines only, with no open water. Processed at our Langfang, Hebei plant at about 42 days; delivered chilled at 0–4 °C by refrigerated truck, arriving 05:00 daily. SC licence and quarantine certificate per batch; annual contracts.

experiences.name: Jingwei Central Kitchen 京味中央厨房 – Roast Duck Accompaniment Sets
experiences.description: Everything that goes on the table beside the duck: thin lotus-leaf pancakes (荷叶饼) steamed and stacked, sweet bean sauce (甜面酱), scallion and cucumber batons, and white sugar portions for dipping the skin. Pancakes are made from wheat flour and water at our central kitchen in Tongzhou, and vegetables are cut that morning. Sized for 150+ covers and delivered chilled in sealed food-grade tubs by 06:30 daily.

experiences.name: Pinggu Jinhe Duck Farm 平谷金河鸭场 – Roast-Ready Pekin Duck Blanks
experiences.description: Roast-ready white Pekin duck blanks for Beijing roast-duck kitchens: scalded, eviscerated through a small side incision and skin air-separated, ready to hang. Dressed weight held to 2.4–2.6 kg, skin-checked; capacity 800 birds a day. Raised in barns at 4 birds/m² (about 11 kg/m²) at finishing, with access to a netted, roofed yard holding a fenced 30 cm-deep bathing pool of filtered, recirculated water. Farmed and processed in Pinggu District, Beijing, 90 minutes from Chaoyang; vacuum-tray packed in sixes, delivered chilled at 0–4 °C, arriving by 06:00 daily. SC licence and quarantine certificate per batch; annual contracts.

experiences.name: Yanzhao Orchard Fuelwood 燕赵果木 – Hung-Oven Fruitwood
experiences.description: Split jujube and pear wood from orchard prunings, the traditional fuel for hung-oven roasting, kiln-dried to below 20% moisture for a steady, low-smoke burn. Sourced from orchards across Hebei and offered on a one-year supply contract, with weekly delivery in 1-tonne bulk bags and a forklift drop at your loading door.

experiences.name: Lurun Food 鲁润食品 – Standardised Roast-Ready Duck Blanks
experiences.description: Standardised roast-ready white Pekin duck blanks built for chain kitchens: scalded, eviscerated through a small side incision and skin air-separated, ready to hang. Dressed weight held to 2.4–2.6 kg, skin-checked; capacity 2,000 birds a day. Raised in enclosed multi-storey barns on slatted floors at 8.5 birds/m² (about 23 kg/m²) at finishing, nipple drinker lines only, no open water. Farmed and processed in Dezhou, Shandong; vacuum-tray packed in sixes and delivered chilled at 0–4 °C, arriving by 06:00 daily after an overnight 4.5-hour drive. SC licence and quarantine certificate per batch; annual contracts.

experiences.name: Sumei Vegetarian Foods 素美 – Braised Mock Duck (素鸭)
experiences.description: Rolled tofu-skin vegetarian duck, braised in soy sauce and five-spice until glossy, then portioned for slicing as a cold starter or a meat-free menu item. The tofu skin is made from non-GM soybeans in Langfang; packed in 500 g portions and delivered chilled three times a week.
